body: My work has been in financial products where mistakes cost people money: lending at Shecluded, payments at Foodlify, compliance at Youverify.
I design and build: this concept is a working prototype in React, built with AI tools, and I built a component library that cut developer onboarding by 45%.

systemsGets: Someone who designs and builds the states of consequential work (needs attention, ready, submitted, paid) as reusable components.

opportunity.title: Payroll Preflight
opportunity.problem: Payroll review usually means scanning a table of everyone. EY found errors in 1 in 5 payrolls, at $339 each to fix.
opportunity.solution: Open on what changed and what's wrong, with a reason and a fix each, block submit only on must-fix issues, then show what happens next.

firstWeek.intro: My first week would follow Bolto's 30-day plan: learn the product, find a high-impact usability issue, and start shipping.

days.body: Meet the team, set up the frontend and run a test payroll end to end.
Review customer tickets and corrections with the payroll team.
Pick one high-impact usability issue, grounded in evidence.
Design and build the fix in the codebase, with edge cases.
Open the PR, demo it, and plan how to measure it.

ask: I'd love to design and build Bolto's experience, starting with the moments where money moves.
